notes:
Summary: Horizon Vault is a mid-size defense analytics integrator building a secure enterprise search layer for multiple DoD customers. Primary requirement: air-gapped on-prem inference for classified corpora; heavy emphasis on embeddings + reranking to deliver high-precision retrieval across a 100M+ doc archive. Short bullets below are direct AE/SE notes and call fragments.

Account background and fit:
- Organization has existing ETL + DMS pipelines (SharePoint, NITRO archive dumps). Looking to add semantic retrieval and contextual reranking for analyst workflows.
- Procurement-heavy: requirements flow through prime contractor; Horizon Vault acts as integrator/subcontractor for agency ATO.
- Prefers vendor with on-prem installer + SCIF deployment playbook. Redwood Private + Optimize seen as core fit.

Technical scope / metrics asked for on calls:
- Corpus: 120M documents (~60–180 TB raw, variable ingestion formats).
- Indexing target: incremental reindexing cadence daily; need block-level embeddings for 4B+ vectors projected in steady state.
- Latency SLO: P95 search + rerank end-to-end <= 300ms for analyst queries (target P90 150ms).
- Throughput: initial cluster to handle 150 qps burst, sustained 25 qps.
- Cost target: marginal cost per query (emb+rerank) <$0.03 for baseline procurement modeling.
- Model preferences: open LLMs allowed if quantized and vetted; must support CPU fallback for low-classification workloads, and GPU-accelerated private inference for production.

Security / compliance notes from SecOps:
- Must integrate with on-prem HSM/KMS for key material; no cloud-hosted keys allowed for controlled datasets.
- Audit log retention: 7 years for certain threads; need tamper-evident logs exportable to customer SIEM.
- Data residency: all inference and cache must remain inside air-gapped environment; optional export pipeline only after formal declassification.
- Requested deliverables: detailed network diagram, RBAC matrix, patching policy, vulnerability scan cadence, ATO evidence pack (RMF controls mapping).

POC asks and experiment design discussed:
- 30-day POC in customer secure lab using subset of 5M docs (approx 6–8 TB) to validate indexing throughput, vector store sizing, and reranker latency. SE to provide test harness and seed prompts.
- Evaluation harness: precision@5, MRR, latency CDFs, cost per q calculation. Customer will supply 50 canonical queries and 200 eval labels.
- SE suggestion: use Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching) to hit latency/cost targets; also propose offline reranking ablation (cross-encoder vs light-weight transformer).

- 2024-09-02: Initial inbound via channel partner; AE assigned. (created)
- 2024-11-14: Intro demo (hosted) — positive reaction to reranking examples.
- 2025-02-04: Security deep-dive with NetSec and SecOps — sent preliminary security FAQ.

- 2025-05-28: On-prem deployment constraints call; SecOps provided additional questions (ff_20250528_security_walkthru).
- 2025-06-12: Received draft RFP from prime; procurement expects vendor SOW by 2025-07-01.
- 2025-06-18: Pricing review & redline kickoff; AE to circulate redlined SOW. (last activity)

- "We need deterministic behavior — if a search went fast yesterday it needs to go fast tomorrow." — SecOps Eng, Horizon Vault.
- "If you can't run in our SCIF, we can't progress." — Program Manager (procurement).

Open items for Redwood sales/SE:
- Provide detailed sizing worksheet for 120M doc projection (vector store growth model).
- Finalize on-prem installer checklist (HSM, network, OS baselines).
- Draft SOW with ATO support hours and optional extended SLA for 24/7 coverage.
- Cost modeling: produce two procurement bundles — (1) 12-month reserved dedicated private cluster, (2) 36-month enterprise private with capacity commitments + Optimize add-on.

Next steps (near term):

- SE (Marcus Li) to deliver sizing worksheet + POC runbook by 2025-06-30.

- Customer values detailed documentation and reproducible performance numbers; low tolerance for product ambiguity. Keep responses tight and prescriptive.
- Expect long procurement cadence; nurture with technical touchpoints and pre-approved artifacts.
